query: I was walking my golden retriever earlier this morning, and he stopped to dig up a really weirdly smooth, grey rock in the park, it almost looks like it could be a tiny piece of meteorite, I’ve been showing it to all my neighbors because it’s so unusual. I also just picked up a new sourdough starter from the local bakery yesterday, I fed it last night and it’s already doubled in size, I’m so excited to bake my first loaf with it this weekend. Oh right, I actually called because my SIM card is locked with a PIN, and my line is suspended, I think it’s because I have an overdue bill, can you help me fix this?
